html:
Greetings, Agents.

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

The battle between those who wish to shatter the order of the gods 
and those who stand to protect it begins!

 

In this Update Details, we are introducing the May Update,
featuring the Gods and the God Butcher theme.

 

Gorr, driven by a vengeful crusade to annihilate all deities, 
and Valkyrie, the guide of fallen warriors to Valhalla, 
have received New Uniforms and Tier-4 Advancements.

 

Additionally, a New Uniform has been added for Odin, 
the All-Father and protector of Asgard.

 

To help you acquire the powerful "Additional Pierce Damage Increase" stat more easily, 
we have improved the Premium Comic Card Craft system. 
We have also eased reward requirements and enhanced rewards 
for Dimension Rifts and Alliance Conquest.

 

Other improvements to make the game more enjoyable have been added as well, 
so please check the details below!

 

 


▣ Three New Uniforms


To celebrate the Gods and the God Butcher themed update, three new Uniforms have been added.
Check out the abilities of Gorr <The God Butcher>, Odin <Lord of Asgard>, and Valkyrie <Asgardians of the Galaxy>.
* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.
* The three new Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off during the <May Update Celebration Event> and can be checked and purchased in the Marvel Universe and Uniform Room after the Event.

 

 

 

 

 


▣ Gorr and Valkyrie Tier-4

 

Tier-4 Advancements have been added for Gorr, whose life purpose is now to punish the arrogant gods who failed him, and Valkyrie, the shield of Asgard dedicated to maintaining divine order.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 

 

▣ Dispatch Mission Sector 15

 

New mission requests have arrived for Dispatch Mission, 
where you can deploy heroes to eliminate threats and earn rewards. 
The destination is a base located in the snowy mountains, 
confirmed to be under the control of Hydra.

 

1. Sector 15 <Hydra Snow Mountain Base> has been added.
- Completing the specific challenges for each stage will increase the maximum Supply time.

 

 

2. In Sector 15, you can obtain Power of Demiurge (growth material for Elite Gear) as a Supply reward.

 

- Higher total Growth Scores of dispatched heroes will yield more Supplies.

 


▣ Premium Comic Card Craft Improvements

 

We have improved the system so that you can obtain the "Additional Pierce Damage Increase" stat—essential for conquering high-difficulty content— through Craft Bonus Options.
We have adjusted the balance of craft options to increase accessibility to this stat.

 

The values granted when setting 3/6 ★ (Blue) have been adjusted, 
and the adjusted amount has been added as an effect based on Craft Progress.
* Other star colors (Red, Green) remain unchanged.
* Craft Bonus options have been added. Effects can be obtained based on the number of crafted stars. 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Future Pass Plus Season & Special Icons

 

A new season of Future Pass Plus will begin after the update.

 

[Future Pass Plus Rewards]

 

- The Future Pass Plus effects will apply immediately upon purchase and cannot be refunded.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic that has been unlocked will only be applied during the season the Pass was purchased. 
The Pass rewards will only be available during the same season.
- The Future Pass Plus - Mythic can be purchased after purchasing the Future Pass Plus - Legendary.
- Future Pass Plus - Legendary / Mythic will not be available for purchase when the season is about to end. 

​​

New Special Icons that will represent Agents have been added.
Collect two new Icons as Future Pass Plus rewards, 
one as an Otherworld Battle reward, and one more from the upcoming Event!

 

[May Update New Special Icon]

 

 

 

 

  

 

▣ Update Hot Deals

 

Update Hot Deal products have been added.
- Event Schedule: 
After the 5/19 Maintenance - 6/16 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 5/19 Maintenance - 6/16 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Find various update celebration products like Hot Deal! 100M Gold Pack, and Hot Deal! Custom Gear Unequip Pack in the Hot Deals category in the Store.
Please check the details in-game after the update.

 

 


▣ Other Improvements and Changes

 

1. Tier-3 Advancement Material Requirements Reduced
- The amount of materials required to advance from Tier-2 → Tier-3 has been reduced.

- Material requirements for Potential Enhance, Gear Upgrade (+21 to +25), and Tier-3 Advancement have been reduced.

- Materials and costs required for Potential Transcendence remain the same.

 

2. Dimension Rift: Improvements have been made to certain features.

 

① Adjustments have been made so that you can still obtain the Progress Completion Bonus if you clear a stage by consuming an entry count, even after reaching 100% Progress.
- This also applies to Rifts you opened yourself.

 

② The number of available entries upon opening a Dimension Rift has been changed.
- Before: Unlimited
- After: 10 times

 

③ Adjustments have been made to the balance of Stage Clear Rewards and S.H.I.E.L.D. Archive collection items.
- The Progress Points obtained upon clearing a stage have been adjusted for each difficulty level.

 

④ The Event Points obtained upon clearing a Dimension Rift stage have been adjusted.
- This applies to Future Pass, Cosmic Core, Timeline Survival, Faction Battle, etc.

 

3. Alliance Conquest: Contribution reward balance has been improved. 

 

[5/21 (Thu) 9:28 (UTC+0), 5/21 (Thu) 2:28 (PDT) added]

We have corrected the reward amounts displayed in the 'Normal League: Contribution Reward Improvements (Contribution Count: 20 Times)' notice.

  • - Please note that the actual in-game reward amounts will remain unchanged.

 

 

 

 

- You can now check the quantity of rewards available in the Contribution Reward Chest.

 

4. My Team: Improved filter functions to check if a hero has an Artifact equipped.

 

 

5. Giant Boss Raid: You can now see invitation notifications via the chat screen even if you do not accept the pop-up immediately.

 

6. Improved an issue where the red dot notification persisted when Card Deck 2 was open but no cards were equipped or there was no applied content.

 

7. When using certain Hero Selector items, heroes exclusive to specific packs will now display an "Premium" label in the selection list.

 

8. Craft: Improved the system to allow crafting "Rune of the Unknown" using Elemental Runes (Normal/Radiant) as materials.

 

9. Certain event details have been adjusted as follows:
- Ranked Tournament: In-game battle time changed from 45 sec → 2 min.
Buffs are added when the remaining time reaches 45 sec.
- Hero Pursuit: Game speed is now set to 2x by default.

 

10. Alliance Tournament: Following adjustments to the Alliance Tournament score balancing, whether or not "Revive" is triggered will now be factored into the score calculation.

 

11. Skill Name Glossary: Certain text in the description for "Time Freezing" has been modified.

 


▣ Game Error Fixes
 
1. S.H.I.E.L.D. Academy: Fixed an issue where Potential Awakening missions appeared for heroes who had already completed their awakening.


2. Improved the Premium Comic Card Change Auto Option feature so that Premium Boost Comic Cards are no longer automatically selected.


3. Fixed an issue in World Boss Legend+ <Corvus & Proxima> where the boss's special pattern was repeatedly triggered under certain circumstances.


4. Fixed an issue where certain effects of Loki <Young Avengers> Uniform skills were not displaying properly.

 


We will return with various content improvements, so please stay tuned.


Thank you.
